title: erdal-b-dot/p53-carvacrol-md-pipeline: v2.0.0 — Revision release (3 replicas + apo control, revised MM-GBSA)
description:
v2.0.0 — Revision release.

Reproducible pipeline for microsecond GROMACS molecular dynamics of carvacrol with the wild-type p53 DNA-binding domain (PDB: 1TSR), supporting the manuscript "Carvacrol Makes Only Transient, Weak Surface Contact with the Wild-Type p53 Core Domain in Microsecond Simulations and Shows Non-Selective Millimolar Cytotoxicity in Breast Epithelial Cells."

New in v2.0.0:

  • Two additional independent 1 µs holo replicas (replicas 2 and 3; randomized initial velocities, otherwise identical conditions) and one 1 µs ligand-free (apo) control.
  • Processed reproducibility outputs for all four systems (RMSD, RMSF, radius of gyration, SASA, minimum protein–ligand distance, contact count, per-residue contact frequency, H-bond occupancy, PCA), plus a cross-replica summary table.
  • Revised end-state MM-GBSA protocol (GB-Neck2, igb = 8, mbondi3, 199 frames over 5–995 ns, 310 K); reported as a qualitative, ensemble-level indicator only, with no dissociation constant derived.
  • Per-residue MM-GBSA decomposition repeated over the complete receptor.

System: Protein force field AMBER99SB-ILDN; ligand GAFF2 (AM1-BCC, ACPYPE); water TIP3P; 0.15 M NaCl; 310 K; GROMACS 2024.1; TRUBA HPC.

Raw trajectory files (.xtc/.trr) are not included due to size and are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
